title: Adelheim
ability_effect: Activate during the nemesis draw phase: When a nemesis attack or power card is drawn but before it is resolved, you may discard it. It has no effect. (The nemesis does not draw a replacement card)

title: Alcheia
ability_effect:
Activate during any ally's casting phase:
Destroy up to three cards in hand. Draw a card for each card destroyed this way.
OR
When a player casts a spell this turn, it deals 1 additional damage for each card that costs 1 Æ or more in your hand. Alcheia may spend 4 charges during any ally's casting phase to activate this ability.
rules:
Setup: Shuffle all of the facet cards together facedown to form the facet deck.

Rules: When a facet is destroyed, place it on the bottom of the facet deck.

title: Arachnos (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Return up to three cards that cost 4 Æ or less from your discard pile to your hand.
OR
Any player gains 3 life.

title: Arachnos (Outcasts)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast any player's prepped spell. That spell deals 3 additional damage.
rules: Xaxos: Outcast cannot gain charges Arachnos would gain from Convergence.

title: Auren
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast any number of spells prepped to breaches with relics attached to them without discarding those spells.

title: Bayli
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Return up to two spells from your discard pile to your hand.
Choose up to two of your prepped spells. Cast those spells.
Then, cast one of your prepped spells.

title: Brama
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any player gains 4 life.

title: Brama (The Descent)
ability_effect:
Activate during any player's main phase:
Gain 4 life.
You may suffer 2 damage. If you do, Gravehold gains 4 life.

title: Cairna
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Gain a spell that costs 5 Æ or less from a supply pile. You may lose two charges to gain any spell from a supply pile instead. You may lose a charge to prep a spell in your discard pile to one of your opened breaches.
rules: Cairna's ability can be used when she has 3 or more charges. When Cairna uses her ability, she loses 3 charges.

title: Claudia
ability_effect:
Activate during any ally's main phase:
That ally gains 2 Æ. The next time that ally gains a card from a supply pile this turn, you gain a copy of that card from the supply pile.
OR
That ally gains 5 Æ.

title: Claudia (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Any player gains 3 life.
OR
The next time you gain a card this turn you may place it into any ally's hand. Then, any ally gains a copy of the same card and places it into their hand.

title: Dezmodia
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any player destroys an opened I or II breach and returns any spells prepped to that breach to their hand. That player gains a Sigil breach and places it where the destroyed breach was. Then, that player may prep a spell from their hand to a breach.

title: Dezmodia (Beyond the Breach)
ability_effect:
Reveal the top two cards of Dezmodia's Stash and choose one to put into play and one to put on the bottom of that deck.
OR
Any player gains 3 life.
rules:
Shuffle and place the seven level 2 treasures that come with Dezmodia next to her mat facedown to form Dezmodia's Stash. You may customize this deck with other level 2 treasures from your collection, but it must start with at least seven level 2 treasures.

If you place a treasure that resolves "at the start of the game" into play using Dezmodia's ability, resolve that effect immediately. If you place a treasure that resolves "after a player has finished resolving their ability" into play using Dezmodia's ability, resolve that effect immediately as well.

title: Dezmodia (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Return up to two spells from your discard pile to your hand. You may prep two additional spells to each of your opened breaches this turn.

title: Dezmodia (Outcasts)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any ally draws three cards. Then, place any number of cards in your hand into their hand. Then, that ally places the same number of cards in their hand into your hand.
rules: Dezmodia's IV breach is the Void breach. Any number of spells may be prepped to an opened Void breach. When Dezmodia is exhausted, she does not discard her Void breach.

title: Dorian
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Gain 3 Æ
The next time you gain a spell this turn, prep it to any player's opened breach.

title: Garu
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Discard up to four of your prepped spells.
Deal 2 damage plus 4 additional damage for each spell you discarded divided however you choose to the nemesis or any number of minions.

title: Gex
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Destroy up to two cards in your discard pile that cost 0 Æ.

Any ally draws one card and gains 2 life.

title: Gygar
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Place a Surge token on your Ancient Breach.
OR
Cast a spell prepped to your Ancient Breach. Gain 2 charges.
rules: Gygar's I Breach is the Ancient Breach. Up to ten Surge tokens can be placed on this breach. When a spell is cast from an Ancient Breach, that spell deals 1 additional damage for each Surge token placed on that breach.

title: Gygar (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast two of your prepped spells without discarding them.
rules: At the end of your casting phase, place a storm token on each of your prepped spells. When a spell is cast, it deals +1 damage for each storm token on it. When a spell with storm tokens on it is discarded, discard the storm tokens on it. Each spell can have no more than 3 storm tokens at once.

title: Ilya
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast all of your prepped spells without discarding them. Any ally returns a card in their discard pile to their hand.

title: Ilya (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Reveal the top four cards of your deck. Place any number of spells revealed this way into your hand. You may prep spells to closed breaches this turn. You may prep up to two spells to each of your breaches this turn.

title: Inco
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast any number of Rose Thorns prepped by any number of players. Those spells deal 2 additional damage.
rules: Set aside all of the Rose Thorn cards. These cards form the Rose Thorn deck. This is not a supply pile. Cards in this deck can be gained using Inco's Verdant Emerald. Additionally, Inco may spend 2 Æ to gain a card from this deck.

title: Inco (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Harvest up to two cards in your hand or discard pile. Resolve the Harvest effects of these cards twice.
OR
Gravehold gains 5 life.
rules: Only cards that start the game in Inco's hand or deck can be Harvested. When a card is harvested, destroy it.

title: Inco (The Surface)
ability_effect: Cast any player's prepped spell. Two different players reveal their decks. They each place up to two Firethorns from their deck and discard pile into their hand. They return their decks in the same order.
rules: Shuffle the Firethorn cards together to form the Firethorn deck. This is not a supply pile. The top card of this deck is always revealed. Inco may spend 5 Æ to gain the top card from this deck.

title: Indira
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Cast any number of spells in hand. Those spells each deal 1 additional damage.
You may destroy a card in your discard pile.

title: Indira (Beyond the Breach)
ability_effect:
Cast a spell in any ally's hand without discarding it. Then, cast it again.
OR
Gain 5 Æ that can only be used to gain a spell.
rules: Indira's III breach is the Transfer breach. When a spell is cast from the opened Transfer breach, that spell deals 1 additional damage and is placed into any ally's hand.

title: Indira (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast up to two spells from your discard pile. You may destroy a card in your discard pile.
rules: When you cast a spell from your discard pile, leave it where it is in your discard pile.

title: Janti
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Gain the top card of the Infusion deck and place it into your hand.
OR
Destroy an Infusion in play. If you do, deal 8 damage.
rules: Shuffle the Golden Infusion, Infernal Infusion, Sapphire Infusion, Mirrored Infusion, Iron Infusion, and Spirit Infusion cards facedown to form the Infusion deck and place it next to this mat.

title: Jian
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Cast any player's prepped spell without discarding it.

Then cast that prepped spell again.
(Discard it afterward)

title: Kadir
ability_effect: Activate during any player's main phase: That player may return up to three spells in their discard pile to their hand. That player may prep up to two spells to each of their opened breaches this turn.

title: Kadir (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Either choose a side of a path token that is not on your mat and place it on your mat or flip over one of the path tokens on your mat. Then, if you have four path tokens on your mat, set one aside.
Resolve all of the path tokens on your mat in any order.
rules: Set aside all of the Path tokens.

title: Kain
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
If Gravehold has 15 life or more, Gravehold suffers 2 damage and any player gains 6 Æ tokens. Otherwise, Gravehold gains 5 life.
rules: Kain's III breach is the Spirit breach. When a spell is cast from Kain's open Spirit breach, it deals an additional 1 damage and any ally gains an Æ token.

title: Kavoc
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Any ally draws two cards.
Gain 3 Knowledge.
rules: Place Brain Lance and Soulstone in the Swap zone.

title: Kel
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Return up to two gems or relics you played this turn to your hand. Any ally draws a card and may prep a spell in hand to an opened or closed breach.

title: Kel (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any ally places up to two cards from their hand or discard pile into your discard pile. Then, if you have ten or more cards in your discard pile, shuffle any player's turn order card into the turn order deck.

title: Kiri and Phoenix
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Prep the top card of the Phoenix deck to the Phoenix breach. Cast that spell. Repeat this once.
rules:
Place all the Phoenix spell cards that cost 3 or more in the Swap zone. Set the Phoenix mat to the side of Kiri's Mat. Shuffle Phoenix Spark, Phoenix Ember, and Phoenix Flare and place them facedown to the left of the Phoenix mat to create the Phoenix deck.
The Phoenix breach and Kiri's breach both cannot be destroyed.

title: Lash
ability_effect: Activate during any player's main phase: Shuffle any player's turn order card into the turn order deck. That player suffers 1 damage.

title: Leisan
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Place the Manifest token on your player mat so that it covers this ability and resolve its "IMMEDIATELY" effects. You cannot activate this ability again this game.
rules:
Shuffle the Giga Inferno, Hulking Comet, Mountain Gust, Titanic Jasmite, and Towering Obelisk cards together facedown to form the Ultimate Form deck and place it next to this mat. Cards can only be gained from the Ultimate Form deck using Leisan's ability.

Place the Manifest token next to your mat; it does not begin in play.

title: Lilly
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Return up to two minions from your discard pile to your hand. You may prep up to two spells to each of your opened breaches this turn.
OR
Deal 3 damage to a minion. If you defeat a minion from the nemesis deck this way, place it into your discard pile.
rules:
Minions in your hand, deck, discard pile, and prepped to your breaches are considered spells with a cost of 0 Æ.

When a minion is cast, it deals damage based on its nemesis tier. Tier 1 minions deal 3 damage. Tier 2 minions deal 6 damage. Tier 3 minions deal 9 damage.

If an ally has a minion in their hand, they place that minion in the nemesis discard pile and draw a card.

title: Lost
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Return up to four cards that cost 0 Æ in your discard pile to your hand.
rules: Set aside all of the Forged Crystal and Forged Spark cards. These form the Forged Deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Lost's Heart Forge. Forged Sparks and Forged Crystals count as Sparks and Crystals respectively.

title: Lost (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Deal damage equal to the number of spells in your discard pile.

title: Lucien
ability_effect: Activate during your casting phase: Open all of your breaches. Prep any number of spells in hand to your opened breaches.
rules: Lucien's II breach is the Channel breach. When a spell is a cast from an opened Channel breach, the player who cast that spell gains 2 Æ. Lucien's III breach is the Tide breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Tide breach, the player who cast that spell destroys a card in hand or discard pile. Lucien's IV breach is the Flood breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Flood breach, that spell deals 3 additional damage. When a spell is cast from one of Lucien's breaches, after that spell resolves, return that breach to its starting position.

title: Malastar
ability_effect: Gain a spell from any supply pile. You may prep that spell to any player's opened breach.

title: Malastar (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Draw a card from the top or bottom of the Inventions deck and place it into an ally's hand.
rules: Shuffle all of the Invention cards together facedown to form the Inventions deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Malastar's Burst of Inspiration ability.

title: Mazahaedron
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: You may gain a gem that costs 4 Æ or less from any supply pile.
Gravehold gains 4 life.

title: Mazahaedron (The Descent)
ability_effect:
Activate during any player's main phase:
Gain a card that costs 4 Æ or less from any supply pile. Any ally gains a destiny token.
OR
Any player returns a destiny token to its supply and draws five cards.
rules:
Setup: Set aside the destiny tokens.

Rules: When a player gains a destiny token, they place that token in front of them. For the rest of the game, that player resolves all of their destiny tokens at the end of their turn after refilling their hand.

title: Mazra
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Destroy a card with "Mazra" in its name in your hand. Gain a card with "Mazra" in its name from the personal upgrade deck that costs 3 Æ more than the destroyed card and place that card into your hand.
OR
Return to your hand all cards with "Mazra" in their name in your discard pile.
rules: Mazra's III breach is the Research Breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Research Breach, the player who cast that spell gains 1 charge. Set aside all cards with "Mazra's" in their name that cost more than 0 Æ. These form Mazra's personal upgrade deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Mazra's Research ability.

title: Mazra (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Destroy a card with "Mazra" in its name in your hand. Gain a card with "Mazra" in its name from the personal upgrade deck that costs up to 3 Æ more than the destroyed card and place that card into your hand.
OR
Return to your hand all cards with "Mazra" in their name in your discard pile.
rules: Mazra's III breach is the Research Breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Research Breach, the player who cast that spell gains 1 charge. Set aside all cards with "Mazra's" in their name that cost more than 0 Æ. These form Mazra's personal upgrade deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Mazra's Research ability.

title: Mist
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any ally draws 4 cards.

title: Mist (War Eternal)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast up to three different spells prepped by any number of players. For each spell cast this way, place that spell into any ally's hand.

title: Nadea
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Any player gains 3 life.
If you have five or more cards that cost more than 0 Æ in your discard pile, any ally gains a spell and places it into their hand.
rules: Place Legacy Coin and Spectralite in the Swap zone.

title: Naftir
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Place a Link token on any opened breach.
OR
Cast all the spells prepped to one breach with a Link token on it.
rules:
Setup: Set aside the Link tokens.

Rules: Naftir's I breach is the Consuming breach. Spells cast from the Consuming breach are not discarded. Place spells cast from the Consuming breach underneath it. When you place a third spell under this breach, deal 3 damage and then discard all cards beneath the Consuming breach in any order.

A Link token allows two spells to be prepped to the breach it is on. Only 1 Link token can be placed on a breach. When there are no more Link tokens to be placed, Naftir cannot resolve the first option on his ability.

title: Nook
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. Gain 4 Æ. You may place the next spell you gain this turn into your hand.

title: Nook (Beyond the Breach)
ability_effect: Place up to three cards with Crystal or Spark in their name in your hand or discard pile into the Swap zone. Gain a card from the Swap zone with Crystal or Spark in its name.
rules:
Setup: Place the Infused, Dim, and Empty Crystals and Sparks in the Swap zone.

Rules: To swap a card, place it in the Swap zone. Then place the card you are swapping into on top of your discard pile. When swapping, if the card being swapped to isn't in the Swap zone, place the card being swapped into the Swap zone without gaining the card it would have swapped to.

title: Nook (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Return up to three Crystals from your hand or discard pile to the Regularity deck. Place up to three Anomaly cards from the Regularity deck into your hand.
rules: Set four Crystals and one Spark next to this mat to form the Regularity deck.

title: Nym
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Discard the top card of the nemesis deck. If you discarded an attack card, discard an additional card.

title: Ohat and Ulgimor
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Ohat mode: Suffer 2 damage. Any ally draws five cards and discards two cards in hand.
Ulgimor mode: Cast a spell prepped to Ulgimor's IV Breach without discarding it.
rules: Ohat and Ulgimor's IV Breach is the Essence Breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Essence Breach, the player who cast that spell gains 1 life. Place the Ohat/Ulgimor token on the front of this mat with the Ohat side faceup. When you have 5 or more life, you are in Ohat mode. When you have 4 or less life, you are in Ulgimor mode. When you become exhausted, do not resolve any on-exhaust effects. You can gain life when you have 0 life to become unexhausted.

title: Ona
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Cast one of your prepped spells without discarding it.
Then, resolve all effects on cards in the ability zone in any order.
rules:
Setup: Place Overwhelm, Sustain and Destroy in the Swap zone. No cards begin in Ona's ability zone.

Rules: Cards in Ona's ability zone always have their ability active and are never discarded.

title: Phaedraxa
ability_effect: Activate immediately after a turn order card is drawn: Prevent any damage that the players or Gravehold would suffer during that turn.

title: Qu
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: If you are in Destroyer form, cast up to two different spells prepped by any number of players, and then flip over the Form token. Otherwise, any player preps up to two spells in their discard pile to their opened breaches, and then flip over the Form token.
rules: Place the Form token on the front of this mat with the Destroyer Form side faceup. All of the gems played and spells cast by Qu are affected by the faceup side of the Form token.

title: Qu (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any ally draws two cards. Any player destroys up to two cards in hand or discard pile.
rules: Set the builder and destroyer tokens on your mat with the side labeled "Start" faceup.

title: Qu (Outcasts)
ability_effect: Activate at the end of your draw phase: Draw three cards.

title: Qu (The Surface)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: If you are in Giver Form, allies collectively draw three cards. Flip over the Form card.
Otherwise, cast any ally's prepped spell and place it into your hand. Flip over the Form card.
rules: During setup, place Qu's Form card on your mat with the Giver side faceup.

title: Quilius
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Deal 2 damage for each Trophy token you have.

title: Quilius (The Caverns)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Place the top card of the Challenger deck on top of the nemesis deck. Then, resolve any effects added to your ability by minions in your ability zone.
rules:
Setup: Shuffle Armored Bylek, Leviathan Hatchling, Pentagram Beetle, and Swift Snapper together facedown to form the Challenger deck.
Rules: Cards in Quilius's ability zone are never discarded. Do not resolve their Persistent effects.

title: Raven
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Gain 4 Knowledge. Reveal the top three cards of the Forgotten Ritual deck. You may gain any number of the revealed cards by paying their cost using Knowledge. Place the gained cards into your hand. Place the rest on the bottom of the Forgotten Ritual deck.
rules:
Setup: Shuffle the Forgotten Ritual deck, place it next to this mat, and reveal the top card of that deck.

Rules: The top card of the Forgotten Ritual deck is always revealed. Cards can only be gained from the Forgotten Ritual deck through Raven's cards and ability.

Raven's breaches are the Archive breaches. When a spell is cast from an open Archive breach, Raven gains 1 Knowledge.

title: Razra
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Destroy a card with "Rip" in its name in your hand. Gain a card with "Rip" in its name from the personal upgrade deck that costs 3 Æ more than the destroyed card and place that card into your hand.
OR
Return to your hand all cards with "Rip" in their name you have played this turn or are in your discard pile.
rules: Set aside all cards with "Rip" in their name that cost more than 0 Æ. These form Razra's personal upgrade deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Razra's Train Rip ability.

title: Razra (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Destroy a card with "Rip" in its name in your hand. Gain a card with "Rip" in its name from the personal upgrade deck that costs 3 Æ more than the destroyed card and place that card into your hand.
OR
Return to your hand all cards with "Rip" in their name you have played this turn or are in your discard pile.
rules: Set aside all cards with "Rip" in their name that cost more than 0 Æ. These form Razra's personal upgrade deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Razra's Train Rip ability.

title: Reeve
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Deal 5 damage to a minion. Deal 3 damage to a different minion.

title: Remnant
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Any ally returns two cards in their discard pile to their hand.
OR
Gravehold gains 5 life.

title: Remnant (Beyond the Breach)
ability_effect:
Return up to two spells from your discard pile to your hand. You may prep one additional spell to your III and IV breaches this turn.
OR
Gravehold gains 4 life.
rules: Remnant's III and IV breaches are the Rift breaches. When a spell is cast from an opened Rift breach, any ally draws a card.

title: Reth
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Reveal your deck. Place up to two spells with the same name from your deck into your hand, and up to two spells with that same name from your discard into your hand. Return your deck in the same order.
rules: Reth's III breach is the Unbound breach. Any number of spells with the same name may be prepped to an opened Unbound breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Unbound breach, that spell deals 1 additional damage for each other spell prepped to that breach.

title: Rhia
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Return a card in your hand or discard pile to its supply pile. If you returned a relic, gain a card from any supply pile that costs up to 3 Æ more than the returned card. Otherwise, gain a card from any supply pile that costs up to 2 Æ more than the returned card. Either way, place the gained card into your hand.

title: Rhys
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Gain up to two spells from the supply that cost 5 Æ or less.
You may place up to two spells from your discard pile into your hand.
rules:
Setup: Set aside the Artificial breaches and cost counters.

Rules: At the start of your main phase, if you have no closed breaches, choose an Artificial breach and place it closed side up along the top of your mat. Place a number of cost counters equal to that breach's cost on the breach.

During your main phase, you may spend Æ to remove cost counters from a breach. Any effect that focuses an Artificial breach removes 3 cost counters from it instead.

When all cost counters are removed, open that breach.

If you have removed at least 3 cost counters from a closed Artificial breach this turn, you may prep a spell to it. Rhys can have up to six breaches.

title: Sahala
ability_effect:
Activate during your casting or main phase:
Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Place a spell revealed this way into your hand. If there are no spells prepped to your Celestial Breach, prep up to two spells in hand to your opened Celestial Breach.
rules: Sahala's IV Breach is the Celestial Breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Celestial Breach, that spell deals 2 additional damage.

title: Shoshana
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: After the end of your turn, before another card is drawn from the turn order deck, your Tether takes a turn.
rules: At the beginning of the game, choose any ally. Give that ally the Tether token. That ally will be your Tether for the rest of the game. That ally replaces a Crystal in their starting deck with Soul Facet. If that ally has no Crystals in their starting deck, they replace any card in their deck with Soul Facet.

title: Soskel
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Place an Energize token on any player's breach that doesn't have one.
OR
Discard an Energize token on any player's breach. That player gains 4 life.
rules: When a player casts a spell from a breach that has an Energize token on it, that player gains 1 charge.

title: Soskel (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Players collectively return up to two cards from their discard piles to their hands.
Reveal the turn order deck and return it in any order.

title: Sparrow
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Focus any player's breach. Repeat this three additional times.
OR
Any ally with no closed breaches draws three cards and then preps up to three spells from their hand.

title: Stake
ability_effect:
Return a spell in your discard pile to hand. Until end of turn, you may prep any number of spells to your breach.
OR
Choose a set-aside breach upgrade. Spend Knowledge equal to its cost. Then, add that card and its effect to the Prototype breach.
rules:
During setup, set aside all of Stake's breach upgrade cards.

Stake's IV breach is the Prototype breach. When a spell is cast from the opened Prototype breach, Stake gains 1 Knowledge. Stake's Prototype breach cannot be destroyed.

title: Talix
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Destroy two Sparks in hand. If you do, shuffle your turn order card into the turn order deck.
OR
Gravehold gains 5 life.

title: Talix (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast any number of your prepped Sparks. Those spells deal 2 additional damage. You may destroy a Spark in your discard pile.

title: Taqren
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Focus any player's breach. Any player gains 1 life for each opened breach you have.
rules: Taqren's IV Breach is the Defender Breach. When a spell is cast from an opened Defender Breach, Gravehold gains 1 life.

title: Taqren (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your turn: Focus any player's breach or any ally preps a spell to one of their opened or closed breaches. Repeat this three times.
rules: Taqren's III breach is the Fortified breach. When a spell is cast through the Fortified breach, the player who cast the spell gains Æ equal to the nemesis tier. Taqren's IV breach is the Garrison breach. When a spell is cast through the Garrison breach, it deals additional damage equal to the nemesis tier.

title: Taqren (Outcasts)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: If you are not exhausted, gain 3 life. Otherwise, Gravehold gains 3 life.
rules: On the left side of the front of this mat, there is a barrier track. Place the barrier token on "Any ally draws a card." of the barrier track. When Taqren suffers damage, or is exhausted and would suffer damage, move the barrier token to a different space on the barrier track and resolves the listed effects. When Taqren is exhausted, Gravehold suffers 1 damage per 1 damage Taqren suffers instead of 2.

title: Thraxir
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast up to three spells prepped by any players. If you have three opened breaches, those spells deal 1 additional damage. If you have four opened breaches, you may cast up to four spells and those spells deal 2 additional damage instead.
rules: Thraxir's I breach is the Forged breach. When opened, Thraxir gains a card that costs 4 Æ or less from any supply pile. Thraxir's II breach is the Honed breach. When opened, Thraxir gains a spell that costs 5 Æ or less from any supply pile. Thraxir's III breach is the Refined breach. When opened, shuffle Thraxir's turn order card into the turn order deck. Thraxir's IV breach is the Serrated breach. When opened, Thraxir gains a spell from any supply pile.

title: Thraxir (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate after the turn order deck is shuffled: Reveal cards from the top of the turn order deck equal to the number of opened breaches you have. Return those cards to the top of the turn order deck in any order. You may place the top card of the turn order deck in the turn order discard pile.
rules: Thraxir's I breach is the Memory breach. When a spell is cast from the Memory breach, focus any player's closed breach with the lowest focus cost.

title: Thraxir (The Descent)
ability_effect:
Activate during any player's main phase:
That player focuses a breach. Then, you gain a card from the supply that costs up to twice the focus cost of their opened breach with the highest focus cost.
OR
If that player has no closed breaches, deal 8 damage.
rules: Thraxir's IV breach is the Judgment breach. Spells cast from the Judgment breach deal +1 damage for each other opened breach Thraxir has.

title: Tressa
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Any ally gains 2 charges and may destroy a card in hand or discard pile.
You may place one of your level 3 treasures in play on the bottom of Tressa's Vault. If you do, place the top card of Tressa's Vault into play. If the new card has an effect that resolves "At the start of your first turn of the game," resolve that effect now.
rules: During setup, shuffle and place the five level 3 treasures that come with Tressa next to her mat facedown to form Tressa's Vault. The top card of Tressa's Vault is always revealed. You may customize this deck with other level 3 treasures from your collection, but it must start with at least five level 3 treasures. At the start of the game, reveal the top two treasures from this deck, and place one into play and the other on the bottom of this deck.

title: Ulgimor
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Gain 6 life.
If you are exhausted, any ally gains 5 life instead.

title: Willow
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Gain 5 Knowledge. Cards you gain this turn may be placed on top of your deck.
OR
Gravehold Gains 5 life.

title: Wolf
ability_effect:
Lose all of your doom.
Any ally draws a card. Repeat this for each doom lost this way.
rules:
During setup, set aside the 5 doom tokens.

When you have 5 or more doom, each minion and the nemesis each suffer 10 damage. Then, you suffer 10 damage and lose all of your doom.

title: Xaxos
ability_effect: Activate during any player's main phase: Allies collectively gain 4 charges. Reveal the turn order deck and return the revealed cards in any order.

title: Xaxos (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase: Look at and gain the top card of the Reckoning deck. Then, place it on top of your deck.
OR
Return one Reckoning card from your discard pile to your hand.
rules: Shuffle all of the Reckoning cards together facedown to form the Reckoning deck. Cards in this deck can only be gained using Xaxos's Expand Potential ability.

title: Xaxos (The Abyss)
ability_effect:
Activate during your main phase:
Gain 3 Æ. You may place any cards
you gain this turn into your hand.
You may place a nemesis turn order card in the turn order discard pile on the
bottom of the turn order deck.
If you do, gain an additional 7 Æ.

title: Xaxos (The Void)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Any ally gains 1 charge and discards a random card in hand. Focus one of your breaches. Gain 1 life. Destroy a card in your hand or discard pile.

title: Yan Magda
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Gain a card from any supply pile. If you have four opened breaches, any ally gains a card from any supply pile and places it on top of their deck.

title: Yan Magda (Legacy of Gravehold)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Cast a spell prepped to an opened Incanted breach three times, then reset that breach to its starting position.
rules: Yan Magda's III and IV breaches are the Incanted breaches. Incanted breaches have no special effects.

title: Yan Magda (The Returned)
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Gain a card from any supply pile. Any ally may reset one of their opened III or IV breaches to its starting position. If they do, that ally gains a card from any supply pile and places that card on top of their deck.
rules: Yan Magda's III and IV breaches are the Intoned breaches. When a spell is cast from an opened Intoned breach, any player focuses a breach. Spells cast from opened Intoned breaches deal 1 additional damage.

title: Z'hana
ability_effect: Activate during your main phase: Gravehold gains 7 life.

title: Z'hana (Outcasts)
ability_effect: Activate during any player's main phase: Gravehold gains 5 life. Place two glyph tokens on top of any card in the supply.
rules: Set all the glyph tokens next to this mat. When an ally gains a card with a glyph token on it, that ally or Z'hana resolves that token's effect. Then, that token is returned to Z'hana. When Z'hana gains a card with a glyph token on it, place that glyph token on any card in the supply unless you are playing with one mage. When a card with one or more glyph tokens is removed from the supply, return those glyph tokens to Z'hana.
